blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.description: 'Blitz', a twenty-something Silicon Valley AI startup founder: messy brown hair, grey zip hoodie over a black t-shirt with a small yellow lightning logo, dark blue jeans, white sneakers, black smartwatch, cocky grin.
blitz.special_windup: pulling back a glowing stack of presentation slides
blitz.special_release: flinging the slides forward like throwing cards

vector.name: Dr. Vector
vector.description: 'Dr. Vector', a lanky machine-learning research scientist in his thirties: round glasses, short dark hair with a cowlick, white lab coat over a teal sweater, khaki trousers, brown sneakers, a lanyard badge, an intense focused expression.
vector.special_windup: charging a glowing cyan ball of energy between both hands
vector.special_release: both palms thrust forward releasing the energy

vesta.name: Vesta
vesta.description: 'Vesta', a sharp venture capitalist woman in her forties: sleek silver bob haircut, navy fleece vest over a light blue button-down shirt, grey slacks, brown loafers, gold watch, confident smirk.
vesta.special_windup: raising a rolled-up contract like a baton

moonshot.name: Moonshot
moonshot.description: 'Moonshot', a loud hype-bro founder who pivoted from crypto to AI: slicked-back blond hair, mirrored aviator sunglasses, unbuttoned purple shirt with a gold chain, white chinos, orange high-top sneakers, a wide grin.
moonshot.special_windup: flipping a big gold coin up with the thumb

ada.name: Ada
ada.description: 'Ada', a calm AI-safety research lead woman: long dark braid, green cardigan over a white blouse, black trousers, sturdy boots, small headset microphone, a serious determined expression.
ada.special_windup: raising one open palm with a glowing green hexagon shield forming
ada.special_release: pushing the glowing green shield forward

gigawatt.name: Gigawatt
gigawatt.description: 'Gigawatt', a huge muscular compute baron who hoards GPUs: shaved head and a thick red beard, yellow hard hat, black tank top with a circuit-board print, cargo pants, heavy work boots, a glowing green GPU card strapped to his back.
gigawatt.special_windup: lifting a big glowing GPU card over his head

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.description: 'Prompt', a hyperactive prompt-engineer livestreamer woman: neon pink short hair, oversized gamer headphones around the neck, black hoodie with glowing cyan patterns, ripped black jeans, chunky white platform sneakers, fingerless gloves.
prompt.special_windup: typing on a floating glowing holographic keyboard
prompt.special_release: a glowing chat bubble shooting forward from her outstretched hand

intern.name: Intern
intern.description: 'Intern', a small wiry tireless startup intern: messy ginger hair, oversized bright orange company t-shirt, a lanyard with a big VISITOR badge, cargo shorts, socks with sandals, an energy drink can tucked in the belt, wide manic eyes.

angel.name: Angel
angel.description: 'Angel', a wealthy older angel investor: neat white hair and moustache, light pink polo shirt, white golf trousers, a white golf glove on one hand, two-tone golf shoes, a tanned face and a smug smile, holding a golf club.
angel.special_windup: golf backswing with the club raised
angel.special_release: golf follow-through after striking a ball forward

viral.name: Viral
viral.description: 'Viral', a flashy growth-hacker marketer: spiky teal hair, a bright yellow bomber jacket covered in social-media style badges, a white t-shirt, slim black jeans, red sneakers, holding a small megaphone, an over-excited grin.
viral.special_windup: raising the megaphone to the mouth and taking a deep breath
viral.special_release: shouting into the megaphone, glowing sound-wave rings blasting forward
